unit: Geometry · Chapter 4. Sides and angles of a triangle
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Right triangles are equal if 1) both legs are equal, or 2) a leg and the adjacent acute angle are equal.
stages.headlineEnglish: Right triangles are equal if 1) both legs are equal, or 2) a leg and the adjacent acute angle are equal.

stages.headline: 3) The hypotenuse and an acute angle are equal. 4) The hypotenuse and a leg are equal.
stages.headlineEnglish: 3) The hypotenuse and an acute angle are equal. 4) The hypotenuse and a leg are equal.

stages.headline: The first three follow from the general tests SAS and ASA, because right angles are always equal.
stages.headlineEnglish: The first three follow from the general tests SAS and ASA, because right angles are always equal.

stages.headline: Which data are not enough for congruent right triangles?
stages.headlineEnglish: Which data are not enough for congruent right triangles?

choices: a leg and the adjacent acute angle
